title: Planning: how to use the two Fable usage resets (to be used before March 2027) for the highest-value work: candidate deep-research / deep-audit / strategic-rethink tasks, and a pacing plan for the week we spend them
roadmap_unmapped_reason: operator planning ask 2026-11-10; capacity planning, not a milestone
note: Operator 2026-11-10 ~12:25Z (voice, condensed faithfully): the operator has TWO resets from Claude specifically for Fable, to be used before March. NOT to be used yet. Discuss at the Wed night / Thu planning session and keep it in view in later planning. Goals: (1) decide which tasks suit Fable best. Operator's guess: deep research, deep audit, and strategic rethinking of whether the system is built the optimal way. (2) Build a ready plan so that in the week we spend them, the FIRST round is used up quickly, before the week's halfway mark, leaving time to use most of the second reset too. Inputs to collect: the exact reset conditions (the operator will share what they look like; NOT yet received, so do not assume the window length, scope or model limits); the Fable model id per the environment notes; the weekly reset cadence (Wed ~18:00Z). Planning output: a ranked shortlist of Fable-shaped tasks with their inputs pre-staged (packets, data, the question set) so day 1 starts at once; a pacing schedule (round 1 done before mid-week); and the trigger condition for 'this is the week'. Candidate pool to rank (manager suggestions, operator to confirm): system architecture audit vs the canonical docs; ML programme strategy (ML-PROGRAMME-CONSOLIDATION, consensus/ensembles); desk redesign (DESK-ENTRY-REVIEW-REDESIGN); research-SLO red (survivors_per_month 0); prop portfolio EV (PROP-PLAN-EV-6M); venue scoping (VENUE-SCOPE-HYPERLIQUID, TRADEIFY-FUTURES-EVAL). Rule: nothing spends Anthropic API credits; Fable runs on the plan. 2026-11-10 12:40Z RESET CONDITIONS, from the operator's Usage screenshot (phone 14:36 local = 12:36Z): 'Fable reset · 2', 'All expire 9 Mar' (2027), button 'Reset for free'. Tooltip: 'Refills your Fable allowance and returns what Fable used to your weekly limit.' Note: 'Within a type, the soonest-expiring reset is used first.' Weekly limit context at the time: All models 94% used, resets Wed 19:59 local (= 17:59Z). Planning implications: (1) a reset gives back ONLY what Fable used, so the value is maximised by putting the heavy work on Fable in the spend week. Work run on other models is not refunded. (2) Pacing: burn the Fable allowance early in the week, reset (round 1, before mid-week as the operator wants), then burn the refill. Pre-stage the task inputs so Fable starts at once. (3) Both resets expire 2027-03-09: plan the spend week(s) before then, at least one week of margin.
